annotations.title: Status of a prepaid portfolio appraisal purchase

description: RAIL: PREPAID BALANCE. Receipt reader for purchase_portfolio_appraisals only, keyed by the portfolio operationId plus the original domains list on the same authenticated agent connection: per-name operationIds are derived positionally (<operationId>:<i>), so the same domains in the same order are required to read the same receipts. Reads the original purchase-1 receipts; it does not start or resume delivery and cannot create a purchase. A pending name gives retryAfterSeconds in its receipt; after that delay, recover with purchase_portfolio_appraisals using the SAME operationId and original arguments. A refunded name means service credits returned to the account for that name. Not for the other rails or for a single purchase_appraisal, which is read with appraisal_purchase_status (operationId alone).

domains.description: The original domains list from purchase_portfolio_appraisals, in the original order.

operationId.description: Caller-chosen purchase identifier. Persist it before calling and reuse it with the original arguments after a lost reply; never generate a new identifier for a retry.

name: portfolio_purchase_status
